steps.title: Configure Project Environment
steps.description: Setup Android Gradle build file and project manifests for Android 14 SDK 34 compatibility.

steps.title: Define Application Metadata and Assets
steps.description: Create app-meta and runtime assets with dynamic app identification for cloud sync.

steps.title: Configure Styles and Design Theme
steps.description: Define Tailwind-inspired modern color palette, clean cards, and material styling without external dependencies.

steps.title: Implement Native HTTP Cloud Backend Engine
steps.description: Construct pure Java HttpURLConnection client for authentication, OTP recovery, and CRUD cloud persistence.

steps.title: Build Offline Local Calculation & Business Logic Engine
steps.description: Implement local business rules for profit calculation, customer net credit/debit, POS GST and discounts, and low-stock checks.

steps.title: Develop User Authentication Activities
steps.description: Create secure Login, Registration, and Forgot Password OTP verification interfaces.

steps.title: Develop Executive Dashboard Home Screen
steps.description: Build high-impact executive dashboard displaying today's sales, outstanding udhaar, stock count, and quick action launch pads.

steps.title: Implement Inventory & Stock Management Module
steps.description: Construct stock item catalogue with real-time low stock badges, price margins, and add-item forms.

steps.title: Develop Customer Khata & Udhaar Ledger
steps.description: Implement customer credit ledger with search filters, debit/credit tracking, and direct SMS reminder integration.

steps.title: Implement Sales POS & Invoice Generator
steps.description: Create fast Point-of-Sale cart billing, automatic GST calculations, discount deductions, and shareable receipt generator.

steps.title: Building VyaparPro
steps.description: Compile the complete native APK with full offline-first resilience, live business analytics, and cloud sync.
